start.title: [TODO:ar] Iron Gate
start.text:
[TODO:ar] The gate slams shut behind you.
Falsely accused. Stripped of all favor.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Bitterness will rot you here.
[TODO:ar] You breathe deep. God is still here.
[TODO:ar] Walls are thick. Guards are many.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Hollow Words
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Anger only echoes off the stone.
Hate cannot free you.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You let the bitterness fall.

escape_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] No Way Out
escape_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Every corner is watched.
You sit back down on the cold floor.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Trust where you cannot run.

first_night.title: [TODO:ar] First Night
first_night.text:
[TODO:ar] Lamplight flickers low.
You kneel and whisper His name.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Peace settles on your eyes.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse the day you were born
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Despair feeds nothing.

despair_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Dawn Returns
despair_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Even in darkness, morning comes.
You choose to rise again.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You stand. A new day waits.

morning_work.title: [TODO:ar] A Task to Do
morning_work.text:
[TODO:ar] The keeper points to the buckets.
Water. Floors. Bread to carry.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Pride will earn you the lash.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Work as if for the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lift the bucket without a word.
[TODO:ar] He will see. He always sees.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Hard Lesson
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The keeper's eyes narrow.
You take the bucket in silence.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Work as if for the Lord
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Better to serve than to suffer pride.

lazy_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Caught
lazy_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] The keeper finds you idle.
His voice is sharp and short.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head and lift the load.

faithful_work.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord Is With Joseph
faithful_work.text:
[TODO:ar] Whatever you touch, prospers.
The keeper begins to watch.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Quietly thank God in your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Heaven hears the silent prayer.
[TODO:ar] Boasting ruins what humility built.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Cold Looks
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Other prisoners turn away.
Your words have cost you trust.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow. The Lord lifts the lowly.

trusted_steward.title: [TODO:ar] Keys in His Hand
trusted_steward.text:
[TODO:ar] The keeper hands you the ring.
"All the prisoners — your charge."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] He laughs. You are still a prisoner.
[TODO:ar] You bow. The keys are heavy and warm.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Still a Prisoner
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His face hardens.
The keys remain — but only just.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You take the keys in silence.

two_arrivals.title: [TODO:ar] Pharaoh's Servants
two_arrivals.text:
[TODO:ar] Two new prisoners arrive.
Cupbearer and chief baker. Pale, afraid.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A shepherd does not turn away.
[TODO:ar] You pour them water. They breathe.
[TODO:ar] Cruelty is not in the Lord's house.

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Soft Voice
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Their faces stay heavy.
You cannot turn from them.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You kneel beside them.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Their Eyes
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] They look up, hurt.
Shame settles in your chest.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You ask their forgiveness.

morning_sad.title: [TODO:ar] Why So Downcast?
morning_sad.text:
[TODO:ar] At dawn their faces are dark.
Something troubles them deeply.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Both men look up at once.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Stay silent — none of your concern
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Silence helps no one here.
[TODO:ar] God's gift is not for sale.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Their Burden
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] They sit in silence.
You cannot leave them this way.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Their eyes lift toward you.

greedy_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Gift, Not Goods
greedy_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Their faces fall further.
This is not how the Lord gives.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask freely — it is God's gift
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You smile. "Speak. Tell me."

interpret_offer.title: [TODO:ar] To God Belong Answers
interpret_offer.text:
[TODO:ar] "Do not interpretations belong to God?
Tell me your dreams."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The cupbearer leans forward to speak.

cupbearer_dream.title: [TODO:ar] The Vine
cupbearer_dream.text:
[TODO:ar] "A vine — three branches budding.
I pressed grapes into Pharaoh's cup."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The Lord does not speak through flattery.
[TODO:ar] Words rise clearly in your heart.

flatter_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Truth Only
flatter_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Lies will not honor God.
You must speak what is true.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head and begin.

cupbearer_meaning.title: [TODO:ar] Three Days
cupbearer_meaning.text:
[TODO:ar] "Three branches: three days.
Pharaoh will lift up your head."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His eyes shine with promise.
[TODO:ar] God's gift was never for sale.

demand_wages_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Open Hands
demand_wages_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His face goes cold.
You must serve, not bargain.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Only ask him to remember you
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] "Only remember me," you whisper.

remember_request.title: [TODO:ar] Remember Me
remember_request.text:
[TODO:ar] "When all is well — remember me.
I was stolen from my land."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The baker steps forward, hopeful.

baker_dream.title: [TODO:ar] Three Baskets
baker_dream.text:
[TODO:ar] "Three baskets on my head — birds
ate the bread meant for Pharaoh."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] A lie helps no one in the end.
[TODO:ar] You take a slow breath. Truth.
[TODO:ar] Refusing will not change the dream.

lie_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Deserves Truth
lie_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] A kind lie still leaves him blind.
He must hear what is real.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You meet his eyes with sorrow.

refuse_interp_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Waits
refuse_interp_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] His pleading eyes hold yours.
God has given. You must speak.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You begin softly, with care.

baker_meaning.title: [TODO:ar] Hard Words
baker_meaning.text:
[TODO:ar] "Three baskets: three days.
Pharaoh will lift you on a tree."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You sit with him until the lamp dims.

third_day.title: [TODO:ar] The Third Day
third_day.text:
[TODO:ar] Pharaoh's birthday dawns.
Guards come for both men.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lay a hand on each shoulder.
[TODO:ar] Anger will only earn you chains.

rage_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Be Still
rage_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] A spear lowers toward your chest.
You fall back, breathing hard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You whisper a prayer instead.

wait_news.title: [TODO:ar] Word Returns
wait_news.text:
[TODO:ar] It is as you said.
The cupbearer lives. The baker does not.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You sit by the small window.
[TODO:ar] Bitterness blinds the watchful eye.

curse2_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Let It Go
curse2_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Hate cannot reach Pharaoh's hall.
Only God can.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You release the bitter knot inside.

forgotten.title: [TODO:ar] Forgotten
forgotten.text:
[TODO:ar] Days. Months. Two long years.
The cupbearer remembers him not.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Despair will steal the morning.
[TODO:ar] You whisper, "He has not forgotten."
[TODO:ar] The guard takes nothing. You lose more.

despair2_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] A Soft Light
despair2_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Through the window, a single ray.
God is still near.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You rise. Hope is not gone.

bribe_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Empty Hands
bribe_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] He laughs. Your bread is gone.
No one will buy your freedom.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Only God can open this gate.

still_trust.title: [TODO:ar] The Lord Is With You
still_trust.text:
[TODO:ar] Even forgotten by men,
you are not forgotten by Him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The keys jingle softly at your side.

ending.title: [TODO:ar] His Time Will Come
ending.text:
[TODO:ar] The lamp burns. The Lord watches.
Pharaoh's dream is yet to come.
